scope: G1 N2/N3 sixteen prior unmapped manual files and eighteen remaining metadata contributor identities. Local primary Git reads only; no K1 writes, resolution, build, adoption, license selection or operational notices.

method.introduction: git log --follow --diff-filter=A plus the exact added path in diff-tree. This locates first path addition, not proof of original creative authorship or no external copy.
method.documents: Original and introducing commits: source-ancestor/root LICENSE/LICENCE variants, README, COPYING/COPYRIGHT/NOTICE/AUTHORS/CONTRIBUTORS/CONTRIBUTING, and Cargo declarations. Source body/header inspected as evidence, never executed.
method.contributorScope: 12 remaining line-author metadata identities plus 6 path-history/coauthor-only identities; do not merge spellings or turn metadata into copyright statements.
method.absenceLimit: No per-person copyright text was recovered in the inspected sources. This is not a global absence finding, permission failure, notice waiver or complete legal attribution audit.

observedFindings.copyDetectorLimit: A constrained git --find-copies-harder=40% introduction-status check reported these paths as additions. It is heuristic evidence, not proof of independent creation.
observedFindings.inlineSdkMaterialLead: CFUserNotification helpers and event-mask helpers have API aliases/inline-function introduction context. Actual SDK/header provenance and rights remain unresolved; do not substitute an unrelated Apple OSS license.
observedFindings.documentationLead: about_generated/list.rs includes list_data.md and list_unsupported.md. License/attribution review of distributed source/docs must include those materials; no additional legacy-MIT grant is inferred from the Rust wrapper.

Treat coauthor-commit line links separately from personal ownership/creative contribution; inspect generated/docs effects if included in the eventual distribution.
